description: Evidence-led mythology candidate clusters for creation, cosmic order, fate, deification, underworld passage, afterlife judgment, and deluge preservation. Broad mythology labels remain advisory; only narrow, explicitly requested motif phrases may activate hard visual obligations.

visual_semantics.primary_visual_proposition: A diver retrieves a small amount of earth from primordial water and that same material becomes the first land.
confusion_boundaries: a diver carrying an unrelated object
a finished island with no retrieval chain

visual_semantics.primary_visual_proposition: One bounded primordial egg breaks and its contained undifferentiated world becomes an ordered outside cosmos through the same rupture.
confusion_boundaries: unrelated shell fragments around a finished cosmos

visual_semantics.primary_visual_proposition: Previously compressed sky and earth parents are actively forced apart, creating the first habitable interval, light, and growth between them.
component_groups: new life in the opened interval
confusion_boundaries: a pillar without a compressed before-state

visual_semantics.primary_visual_proposition: One continuous central structure traverses and organizes three visibly distinct realms while preserving a readable passage between them.
confusion_boundaries: a giant tree in one landscape
three stacked backgrounds with no common axis
a portal that connects only two spaces

visual_semantics.primary_visual_proposition: Three distinct fate agents spin, measure, and cut one continuous life thread whose changed state visibly belongs to the same mortal life.
confusion_boundaries: separate threads with no mortal continuity

visual_semantics.primary_visual_proposition: One formerly mortal subject crosses into divine status while identity continuity, the discarded mortal state, and acknowledgment by the divine order remain simultaneously visible.
confusion_boundaries: an already divine portrait with no mortal before-state

visual_semantics.primary_visual_proposition: A living traveler deliberately crosses downward from the world of the living into a governed realm of the dead for a visible objective.
confusion_boundaries: an underworld portrait with no crossing traveler

visual_semantics.primary_visual_proposition: The deceased's heart and Ma'at feather occupy opposite pans while Anubis operates the balance, Thoth records, and the afterlife outcome visibly waits on the result.
confusion_boundaries: a feather and heart still life

visual_semantics.primary_visual_proposition: A deliberately prepared vessel preserves a bounded living lineage and essential continuity while a world-covering deluge erases ordinary ground.
confusion_boundaries: flooded streets with no preservation lineage

visual_semantics.primary_visual_proposition: An explicitly requested combat-myth scene links a divine champion, a sea-like or dissolutory adversary, direct defeat, and a same-frame ordering consequence without claiming that every variant shares one theology.
confusion_boundaries: victory tableau with no cosmogonic or sovereignty consequence
